# K-Web-UI

> Designed to feel warm and engineered to run hot.

Every docs page has a markdown twin. Start here, or take [/llms-full.txt](/llms-full.txt) in one request.

## Getting started

- [Getting started](/getting-started.md): Install the kit and put a class on a button.
- [How it works](/how-it-works.md): How to read these docs, how the kit is put together, and how to add a theme.
- [Showcase](/showcase.md): Kit pieces used together the way they would sit on a real page.
- [Restyle](/showcase/restyle.md): Same markup. Your CSS. A different look.
- [Theme playground](/theme-playground.md): Override kit tokens and copy a theme into your project.

## Foundations

- [Colors](/foundations/colors.md): Palette steps and the semantic colors that flip with the theme.
- [Typography](/foundations/typography.md): Outfit for UI. IBM Plex Mono for code. Sizes and weights.
- [Styles](/foundations/styles.md): Radius, shadows, and the focus ring.
- [Iconography](/foundations/iconography.md): Fifteen UI icons. CSS masks. Recolor with bg-k-*.

## Components

- [Accordion](/components/accordion.md): details.k-accordion__item. CSS only.
- [Badge](/components/badge.md): span.k-badge. Color, style, size.
- [Banner](/components/banner.md): div.k-banner with role="alert".
- [Button](/components/button.md): button.k-btn. Variants, sizes, block.
- [Card](/components/card.md): div.k-card with optional header, body, footer.
- [Carousel](/components/carousel.md): k-carousel. Track, slides, and controls from slides.
- [Dropdown](/components/dropdown.md): k-dropdown. Trigger, menu, and keyboard from options.
- [Gauge](/components/gauge.md): k-gauge. Square frame with a reading and a caption.
- [Grid](/components/grid.md): div.k-grid or ul.k-grid. CSS only.
- [Input](/components/input.md): k-field, k-label, k-input, k-hint.
- [Link](/components/link.md): a.k-link.
- [Modal](/components/modal.md): dialog.k-modal with popover. No JS.
- [Pagination](/components/pagination.md): k-pagination. Page window and first/last jumps.
- [Progress](/components/progress.md): progress.k-progress. Linear bar.
- [Scrollbar](/components/scrollbar.md): k-scrollbar. Overlay thumbs that hide native bars.
- [Sidebar](/components/sidebar.md): Checkbox-hack drawer. No JS.
- [Spin](/components/spin.md): span.k-spin wraps an icon and rotates it.
- [Table](/components/table.md): table.k-table.
- [Tabs](/components/tabs.md): k-tabs. Tablist, panels, and ARIA from panels.
- [Toast](/components/toast.md): div.k-toast wrapping banners. CSS only.
- [Tooltip](/components/tooltip.md): span.k-tooltip with data-tip. No JS.
